decision_package.title: Verify new dependencies deterministically before install (slopsquatting)
existing_capabilities: npm view <pkg> / registry existence check, npm audit signatures, lockfile + provenance, `ignore-scripts`
consumer projects already pin lockfiles; installs run in devcontainers
decision_package.why_r3: Supply-chain boundary; default-deny dependency policy and sandboxed install scripts are permission/process changes.
decision_package.proposed_action: Decision: adopt a PreToolUse hook or CI check that blocks `npm install <new-pkg>` unless the package exists on the registry with history/publisher and appears in an approved list; require lockfile diff review. Candidate is a project-level hook (R2, reviewed) rather than a shared Skill; if it proves reusable across consumers, promote to a shared hook script later.
decision_package.implementation_target: consumer projects (.claude/settings.json hooks, CI); shared later
decision_package.evaluation: known-positive (fake package name) blocked; known-negative (existing pinned package) allowed; no false blocks on lockfile-only installs
decision_package.controller_note: Classifier proposed shared-new-skill; controller reroutes to project hook first (reuse precedence: platform/config before shared asset).
